subject.title: feat: add model switch choices to /model

question: Should this cross-channel `/model` picker expansion land after a redacted live Slack render-and-select proof, or should it be narrowed to the original Slack-only command-menu gap?
rationale: The change intentionally reaches the shared registry, Discord, and Telegram behavior, while the existing review record identifies a missing Slack proof path. That is a product-scope and evidence-sufficiency choice, not a narrow mechanical defect.

options.title: Require Slack proof and retain scope
options.body: Keep the shared and channel changes, but require a redacted Slack command-menu render and selection result plus green checks on the current head before merge.

options.title: Narrow to Slack only
options.body: Remove the Discord and Telegram picker changes if maintainers want this PR to address only the Slack native slash-command menu.

options.title: Pause for channel ownership
options.body: Leave the PR open without automerge until a channel-command owner confirms the desired cross-channel `/model` experience.

recommendation.title: Require Slack proof and retain scope
recommendation.body: Keep the shared and channel changes, but require a redacted Slack command-menu render and selection result plus green checks on the current head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They initiated automerge and directly maintained the contributor branch through earlier repair cycles.
